participation.context: Stood at the edge of the stall and then went home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You walked two hundred yards, saw the firkins and the constable, heard fourpence, and did not argue.

title: Looked at the butter firkins and the constable

description: A thumb short of the notch

participation.context: Looked at the loaf she had left out, and did not cut it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the loaf against the notch and left it where she had put it.

title: Looked at the loaf a thumb short of the notch

participation.context: Wrote the prices and left the leaf.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You entered the sentence under Prices and did not extend it.

title: Wrote the three prices and the thumb
